review.notes: Fence balance scan, heading scan, whole-document word/4-gram diff and a number-preservation diff (per-page multiset of decimal/large integers) of the OCR Markdown against extracted text of all 21 physical PDF pages; rendered checks at 200-300 dpi covered the physical p.7 benchmark table header, the physical p.6 Table 12 header and the physical p.15 contributions footnote. High 4-gram mismatch rates are explained by the PDF text layer's hyphenated line breaks and column reordering; word- and number-level checks found no dropped prose, tables or references. The print's own inconsistent spellings were preserved (ARC-C in the p.7 table vs ARC-c in Table 12).

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.7 (200 dpi crop inspected) prints a two-row table header whose column labels are 'Gemma-1/2B, Gemma-2/2B, Mistral/7B, LLaMA-3/8B, Gemma-1/7B, Gemma-2/9B, Gemma-2/27B'. The OCR flattened each two-line label into one glued token (Gemma-12B, Gemma-22B, Gemma-227B ...), which misstates the model identities; the patch restores the printed labels with spaces.

Rendered physical p.6 Table 12 (300 dpi crop inspected) prints the column labels 'LLaMA-3 70B', 'Qwen1.5 32B', 'Gemma-2 27B'; the surrounding caption text also prints 'Qwen1.5 32B' and 'LLaMA-3 70B'. The OCR glued the size onto the family name (LLaMA-370B, Qwen1.532B, Gemma-227B); the patch restores the printed labels.

Rendered physical p.15 (300 dpi crop inspected) prints the footnote '* equal contributions.' below the Contributions and Acknowledgments column; the PDF text layer reads '∗equal contributions.' (U+2217). The starred names (Morgane Riviere*, Shreya Pathak*, Pier Giuseppe Sessa*, Cassidy Hardin*) survive in the OCR table but the footnote body was dropped; the patch reinserts it directly after the table containing the starred names.

unresolved.evidence: Memorization figure axis ticks (10-4, 10-3, 0.01, 0.1) are absent from the OCR text; the figure is embedded as an image, so the ticks remain visible to readers.
The arXiv stamp on physical p.1 is absent from the OCR; recurring overlay text, left out deliberately.
